verdict.rationale: Circle is a stablecoin/blockchain infrastructure platform (wallets, CCTP, Gateway, agent-payment rails) rather than an AI agent or assistant that itself consumes external tools; its only MCP-related evidence (circle-docs-9, circle-probe-3) is Circle publishing its OWN MCP server for external LLMs/IDEs to call Circle's APIs, the opposite direction of 'plugging MCP servers into Circle.' Acting as an MCP client/tool-consumer is not a fair axis for this kind of backend infrastructure product.
